(Experience... Does that mean I was taught that somewhere before?)

Thank you very much, Trainer! 
I'm heading home now! Thanks for your hard work~!

All right!
I'm gonna become someone who can be a real help, too~!
Um, Trainer, what does this――

Ah, no no no! Never mind, I'm good!
There's no point if I just ask for the answer, right...!

*inhale*... *exhale*... Calm down, Tsuyoshi...!
*deep breath*... All right!

It was certainly a bit tough, but Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi should be able to figure out the answer.
She had been through enough real experience for it.
I have no cluuuue!

My thoughts are coming together, but
I won't really know until I actually run and test it out!

So moisture content, was it? The amount of water in the turf.
This course dries out a lot better than the numbers suggest, huh!

(Rain, turf, drainage... When was it that someone
told me about that? Hmmm, come on, brain, remember~~!)

If underground culvert drains make it dry quickly, then instead of the crowded outside that everyone takes to avoid rough ground,
there might actually be a chance to win on the inside... right!
Looking over the contents, it seemed to be an assignment requiring her to formulate a theoretical strategy for a race with specific conditions.

I'm not gonna just be the one getting saved!
This summer, I'm definitely going to become someone you can rely on!
Ow-w-w?!

It covers the material from when I was out with a cold, so I'm having a hard time...
Ah, no, but! I'll manage somehow!

*cough*! *hack*! ...Phew, that was close. That one didn't count.
Steady Tsuyoshi doesn't panic.

Ah, Trainer...!
Um, it's my race strategy homework!

Even so, you really are amazing, Trainer!
You knew right away just from looking at it that someone taught me before!

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's determined words spilled from her lips,
only to be absorbed into the indigo night sky.

Since everyone runs the shortest distance on the inside, it gets torn up easily,
so people tend to think it's impossible to run on when soaked with heavy rain, but――

Whoa! That might actually make for a secret winning
strategy... Ah, I need to take notes!

If I'm panicking until someone calls out to me, I still have a long way to go.
Pull it together! Get it together, Tsuyoshi~!

All right, I gotta keep this momentum going and try more stuff!
Let's do thisssss!

"Weather conditions: Heavy rain from 3 to 2 days prior, sunny on race day.
Refer to separate sheet for precipitation amounts, turf type, and baseline moisture content—"

And if there's high moisture here, that means... mmgh!
There are so many factors to consider after all!

Use this to come up with strategies per racetrack and date/time... okay.
Let's see, separate sheet, separate sheet...

Ummm. This one's cool-season grass, and this one's Japanese lawngrass.
Huh? Was overseeding the mix of the two...?

Wait... Whoaaa, dorm curfew's almost here...! 
I completely forgot about the time~!

Just as I thought...!
It's drier than I imagined... I can break out from the inside lane with this!
I slammed straight into the glass face-first... Th-That's so embarrassing~!

She had been like this for a while now,
staring down the assignment and groaning in deep thought.

Whoa~! Subsurface drainage culverts!
So racetracks actually have artificial underground drainage systems~

Hey, Trainer!
Can I use the VR Umalator right now!?

I'm finisheeeeed...! 
It took a ton of time, but this oughta do the trick...!
